rationale: Answers are brief, concrete and taken in order. This fits Cameron's decreased verbal productivity, soft-spoken style and tendency not to raise new topics, as in turns 7 and 9. The patient handles repeated questions consistently and without irritation (turns 5 and 11), which feels realistic. There are minor realism issues. Some replies are unusually tidy and complete. Turn 10 volunteers the full breakdown plus a preference and a reason that weren't asked for, and turn 2 uses slightly formal phrasing. Several answers also read like recited facts rather than natural speech. These are small inconsistencies that don't significantly undermine authenticity.
